name: New Adventure
desc: Ash and the Hero discovered a new area with diverse and breathtaking scenery. They decided to start exploring the surroundings.

name: Sweep Clean
desc: Ahead stands a house. Upon entering, they found it dusty and cluttered. With the Hero’s help, it could be cleaned up quickly.

name: Power for Love
name_vn: Tạo ra sức mạnh cho tình yêu
desc: The research lab here has circuit damage, causing the machines to malfunction. Ash needs to send a trusted partner to assist.

name: Mysterious Fragrance
desc: As the team prepares to move on, a refreshing fruity aroma drifts in with the wind. Tempted, they decide to investigate.

name: Keep Moving Forward I
desc: Ash and the Hero are traveling on the road. The Hero form several squads under Ash’s command to ensure exploration safety.

name: Keep Advancing II
name_vn: Tiếp tục tiến về phía trước Ⅱ
desc: Ash and the Hero are traveling on the road. The Hero form several squads under Ash’s command to ensure exploration safety.

name: Picnic Time
desc: This small grove isn’t large, but the wild fruits on the trees look luscious. Ash and the Hero plan to take a short rest here.

name: Forgotten Relic?
desc: A pile of intricately carved stone pillars blocks the way. Ash decides to carefully move them—this could be some ancient relic!

name: Keep Advancing III
name_vn: Tiếp tục về phía trước iii
desc: Ash and the Hero are traveling on the road. The Hero form several squads under Ash’s command to ensure exploration safety.

name: Crossing the River I
desc: Ash’s team reaches a riverbank and sees a frail wooden bridge that can't be crossed. Ash plans for the Hero to wade through.

name: Crossing the River II
desc: After crossing a river, they encounter another, even wider one. Ash and the Hero must wade through again.

name: Fly
desc: Finally leaving the river behind, Ash's team arrives at the foot of towering green mountains. Ash plans to “fly” to the top.

name: Campfire
desc: It’s quite cold in these mountains, shaded by trees year-round. Ash plans to build a fire and needs help from the Hero.

name: Adventure Preparation
desc: Crossing the forested mountains, they reach a vast desert. The climate suddenly turns hot—preparations are needed to enter.

name: Clear the Trap
desc: Ash’s team needs to pass through waist-high grass, but traps set by hunters seem to be hidden inside. They must be cleared.

name: Keep Advancing
name_vn: Tiếp tục tiến về phía trước
desc: Ash and the Hero are traveling on the road. The Hero form several squads under Ash’s command to ensure exploration safety.

name: Strange Circle
desc: The roadside grass appears trampled over a long stretch—very odd. Ash and the Hero decide to take a closer look.

name: Keep Advancing
name_vn: Tiếp tục tiến về phía trước
desc: Ash and the Hero are traveling on the road. The Hero form several squads under Ash’s command to ensure exploration safety.

name: Source of Life
desc: After long travel, Ash's team is extremely thirsty. They spot lush plants ahead—perfect for drawing some life-saving water.

name: Fort Road I
desc: Upon entering the desert, they encounter a fork in the road. A narrow path seems scenic. Ash sends a scout team to check it out.

name: Extinguish
desc: The scorching sun ignites a dead tree by the road. Thick black smoke and heat block the way—they must extinguish the fire.

name: Search II
desc: Beside the road is a small hill shaped uniquely by the desert wind. Could new Hero be living here?

name: Uncommon
desc: This is supposed to be the fastest way to the town, but the path disappears ahead. Ash decides to split up and map the terrain.

name: Helping Others
desc: It looks like the road leads to a town. Beside it, someone seems to be planting greenery. Ash decides to help out.

name: Fort Road II
desc: It’s the second time they found a fork in the desert. Based on last time, Ash and the Hero don’t want to miss any “treasure.”

name: Asking for Directions I
desc: Not far from the road is a small house that looks inhabited. Ash plans to take a few Hero and ask for directions.

name: Asking for Directions II
desc: Following a local’s guidance, Ash’s team soon finds the nearby town. Night falls, so they plan to quickly find a place to stay.

name: Fort Road III
desc: Yet another fork in the road! This one stretches into the distance. They’ll need to be extremely careful here.

name: All Ready to Go
name_vn: Tất cả đã sẵn sàng để đi
desc: The heat and constant travel have exhausted many Hero. Maybe making some icy food can help them cool down?

name: Sunny Beach
desc: The road ends at an endless ocean. What a stunning view! Ash’s team decides to stop and begin a vacation!

name: Search I
desc: Ash and the Hero stumble upon a lush jungle. The trainer’s instincts say new Hero might live here.

name: Harvest Spring
desc: At the end of the path is a wild field with many berries in the distance. Luckily, there are tools nearby—Ash decides to harvest.

name: Truly Fragrant
desc: It’s an abandoned field. Though overgrown with weeds, it still yields fruit—enough for Ash and the Hero to feast.

name: Pick Up
desc: The forest leaves are needle-shaped and dense. Though the fruit is good, it’s hard to pick. With help, they can eat soon.

name: Eat Like the Wind
desc: Although picking fruit took a lot of effort, the juicy, sweet fruit quenched their thirst—Ash and the Hero couldn’t stop eating.

name: Treasure Under the River
desc: The Hero discovered a trove of “treasure” under the upstream riverbed! But the current is strong—water-type help is needed.

name: Foot of the Mountain
desc: A Hero found a small hidden cave at the mountain's base. There’s a faint glow—could it be more treasure?

name: Treasure in the Air
desc: A flying Hero told Ash the top view looked like a map. Following it, they found a large treasure chest!

name: Small Mine
desc: A scout team found a mine at the end of this path. The entrance is huge with many forklifts—it’ll take effort to explore.

name: Random Harvest
desc: The road is under repair and doesn't lead to town. Luckily, the Hero found a chest full of items!

name: Large Mineral Deposit
desc: As expected, the scout team found another mine, larger than before. The Hero are ready for it.

name: Next Step
desc: After traveling all day, there’s been little progress—no caves or anything. The scout team decides to push ahead.

name: Continue
desc: No caves or pits at this fork. Some Hero are exhausted, but the rest decide to keep going forward.
